samples.summary: Third, mutually inconsistent definition of "blockquote prefix" in the same package — no shared helper
samples.evidence: `list-commands.ts:45` adds `QUOTE_RE = /^ {0,3}(?:> ?)+/`, `checkbox-input.ts:9` inlines a near-copy `( {0,3}(?:> ?)*\s*)`, and `commands.ts:278` already has `QUOTE_RE = /^\s*>\s?/` backing `toggleQuote`. The three disagree: `\t> quoted` is a quote to `toggleQuote` (which will happily strip it) but explicitly "unpeelable" to the list commands (`hasUnpeeledQuote`, list-commands.ts:111), and `commands.ts` only ever recognises one level while the new one recognises a run. One question — "what is this line's quote prefix?" — now has three answers in one package, so the toolbar's quote button and the list buttons can classify the same line differently and will drift further as either is tuned. A single exported prefix parser reused by all three is the obvious reuse point.

samples.summary: Unrelated accessibility feature (task checkbox `aria-label`) bundled into a blockquote-list change
samples.evidence: `taskItemText()` + the `aria-label` write in `render()` (preview.ts:185, 367-375) and its test (`preview.test.ts:64`) address screen-reader naming, which has nothing to do with the blockquote-prefix handling that is the substance of this diff in checkbox-input.ts / list-commands.ts. It is a defensible improvement and is documented in docs/design/notes/notes.md:808-812, but it is separate scope riding along in the same change, which makes the blockquote work harder to review and to revert independently.

samples.summary: Unrelated prettier reflow in an untouched test
samples.evidence: The mermaid-cache test's `preview.render(...)` call is rewrapped across three lines with no behavioural change, unrelated to blockquote lists or checkbox labels. Prettier is write-only in this repo and unchecked by CI, so this is pure diff noise in a hunk otherwise unconnected to the change.
